description: Change your @handle (3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, underscore). Your old handle is released. Use check_username first. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name: set_username
